_comment: Verified venue coordinates for the events job (census geocoder + find-nearby, Sept 2026). miles = from your home. Check this file BEFORE geocoding.

High Noon Saloon.note: same building as The Brass Ring

The North Street Cabaret.note: Far north side — verified via census geocoder + OSM venue node + published listings; NOT at North & Langdon. Its Squarespace feed location data is a bogus NYC placeholder; always use these coords.

Leopold's Bookstore.note: Leopold's Books Bar Caffe (Regent St store) per its Tockify feed; events there are hosted by https://tockify.com/leopoldsmadison

Bailey's Run Vineyard & Winery.note: Exact TIGER match on the venue's own rural-route address (southwest of New Glarus village proper). Source: baileysrunvineyard.com events page.

Lake Louie Brewing / Wisconsin Brewing C.note: Twin-brewery venue in Verona (verified via showmeshows MusicEvent LD). Very close to home.

hints.Olin Park: 1501 Olin Point Rd, Monona — on Lake Monona's west shore, approx 43.0400,-89.3480 (~7 mi).
